name: DiBa SAML
description: Corporate SAML SSO integration for DiBa sites: login-form policy (local/combined/hybrid), IdP-metadata import, multi-environment SP metadata, and samlauth config sync.
project_description: Submodule of DiBa Integration that layers corporate SSO business rules on top of the samlauth module. It adds a validation-mode policy (local Drupal only, combined, or hybrid-by-email-domain) to the user login form, imports raw IdP metadata XML and auto-fills IdP settings, generates multi-environment SP metadata for IdP registration, and synchronizes its settings into samlauth.authentication. SAML protocol validation itself is delegated to samlauth.
